Hush removes background noise from voice and video recordings, entirely on your phone. Nothing is uploaded.

**Install:** download `Hush-*.apk` below and open it. Allow installs from your browser or file manager when Android asks. Needs Android 10 or newer.

**New in 1.2.0: minutes**
- Cleaning and A/B preview are free. Minutes are used only when you save, rounded up to the next minute.
- Saving the same recording again in another format is free.
- 5 free minutes on install. Packs: 60 min ₹49, 150 min ₹99, 400 min ₹199, through Google Play.
- Buying works once Hush is installed from Google Play. In this sideloaded APK the 5 free minutes still work.

**Opens any audio or video your phone can play**
MP3, WAV, M4A/AAC, FLAC, OGG, Opus (WhatsApp voice notes), AMR and 3GP (call and voice recorders), AIFF, WebM, MP4, MOV, MKV and more. Also **Share → Hush** and **Open with → Hush**.

**Saves in every common format** to Downloads/Hush
- Lossless: WAV 24/16-bit, WAV 32-bit float, FLAC 24-bit, AIFF 24-bit
- Compressed: MP3 320 or 192 kbps, M4A (AAC 256 kbps), OGG (Opus 160 kbps)
- Video: the original picture untouched with the cleaned sound swapped in
